verdict.rationale: Docs confirm the core mechanic — flags can be enabled/disabled without redeploy (unleash-docs-18) and SDKs/Edge communicate via API keys with Edge scaling to thousands of connected SDKs (unleash-docs-5, unleash-docs-23, unleash-docs-28) — but there is no explicit documentation of streaming vs. polling propagation times, no stated 'seconds' latency figure, and no hands-on/independent test confirming a kill switch instantly disables a live SDK.  missing for 10: explicit streaming/polling interval docs, measured propagation latency, independent or hands-on confirmation of kill-switch behavior in production SDKs.
